notes.title: Through The Backrooms Demo is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the release of the demo for our highly anticipated game, Through The Backrooms! Now you can witness Ethan’s journey into the unsettling depths of the Backrooms and experience the iconic Level 0 firsthand, for FREE!

The demo allows you to experience Ethan’s first steps into the Backrooms, which will have up to five different endings in the game!

The demo is a great opportunity to see if Through The Backrooms meets your expectations and to help us make the full game even better. Your feedback is incredibly important to us!

Download the Through The Backrooms demo right now on Steam at the following link: [Link to Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3548910/Through_The_Backrooms_Demo/]

Please leave your reviews and share your thoughts in the Steam discussions!

Get ready for an unforgettable adventure!
